releases.body:
Measure tokens per second from a reasoning part only

A tool part's timestamp is when the call begins, after the model has generated, so the fallback opened the window at a fraction of the real one: on rows carrying both parts, 23% of it. An old step with no reasoning part is unmeasured rather than measured fast.

Release oc-models-pro 0.4.2.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md

Measure tokens per second from the first token

A text-only answer carries no timestamped part, so its speed was silently skipped: 17 turns of the last week. The completion instant was also counted as generation time, which reads slow.

Release oc-models-pro 0.4.1.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md

Clear the model search in one click, and let the panel keep its width

The field was a fixed 280px with no way back to an empty box but the keyboard,
and the panel opened at half the window with a drag the app only kept for the
session. Both are the same shape of fix: the field gives its room back before the
filters wrap, and the drag goes to the store the app keeps app-wide.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md

Keep the model in use above the scroll

The panel exists to compare a candidate against the model in use, and
that row left the screen as soon as the list moved. It now sits in a
band of its own, cut from the same sections the body draws.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md
